COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Artificial Intelligence Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.

2. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.

7. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data Analysis and Visualisation.

8. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

9. When learning Data Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Structures.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Career Opportunities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.

12. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social and Ethical Issues in Networking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Data Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development II and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Software Development Life Cycle and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
